8:         if event['kind'] == 'post':
9:             account, amount = event['account'], event['amount']
10:             # If this posting was already marked as cancelled, don't process it
11:             if event['id'] in cancelled:
12:                 continue
13:             postings[event['id']] = (account, amount)
14:             totals.setdefault(account, 0)
15:             totals[account] += amount
16:         else:
17:             target = event['target']
18:             if target in cancelled:
19:                 continue
20:             # Mark the target as cancelled - this will prevent its posting from being processed later
21:             cancelled.add(target)
22:             if target in postings:
23:                 account, amount = postings[target]
24:                 totals[account] -= amount
25:     return totals
